A backup is a single file you save wherever you like. It holds the sections you choose: settings, favorites, playlists and listening history. Restoring merges the file into what you already have and never removes anything. Sign-in tokens, API credentials and proxy passwords are never stored in a backup, and downloaded songs are not included.
